snippet.title: Ashore & Away - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Ashore & Away is a relaxing adventure game where you awaken on a mysterious beach with a single goal: to get home.
*Wishlist now on Steam* : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3838200/Ashore__Away/

Lost and shipwrecked in the Bermuda Triangle, forge your path across an infinite archipelago.
Discover hidden treasures, recruit a loyal crew, and uncover secrets as you craft the ultimate escape raft to sail back home.

In the end, the choice is yours; play at your own pace and explore islands however you like.  
Stay *Ashore* , gather resources, explore, or sail *Away* and venture onto other islands! 
Ultimately, your escape depends on your wits, your raft, and the hidden knowledge of the islands.
